description: #806: Node 22.22.0's single-dash options: -e and -p take their code as the next argument only (-econsole.log(1), -pcode and -e1 are bad options, exit 9), -pe is --print --eval, -ep is a bad option, and V8's flags take one dash as well as two (-stack-trace-limit=5, -stack_trace_limit, -max-old-space-size, with V8's reports for a bad value) while Node's own options need two
